name: Founder to Camera
description: The person who built the thing says why, standing in the place it gets made. Steadier and slower than the UGC formats — one master frame, three beats, no phone-selfie shake — because a founder filmed like a customer reads as a costume. The format for a brand whose story is its differentiator.

why.description: Why this exists at all, in the founder's own terms. Not a benefit — a reason.

proof.description: The concrete thing that proves they mean it: a number, a decision, a refusal.

presenter.description: Casting note, e.g. 'woman, 40s, founder, workshop apron, quiet and certain'.

value.frame: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic portrait, shot on a phone resting on something rather than held — the framing is steady and slightly low. Natural light from a large window or an open door, one direction, soft falloff, real shadows on the wall behind. The working space is genuinely in use: tools, stock, materials, an unswept floor. Workwear with real wear on it. Skin has visible texture, pores and lines, no retouching. Both eyes open, looking directly into the lens, caught mid-sentence.
value.motion: Keep the exact same person, hair, wardrobe and workspace as the reference image. The camera is static on a surface, no handheld shake, no push in. The person speaks directly to the lens, weight shifting slightly, hands moving when they explain something. Ambient depth behind them: dust in the light, something moving far back in the room.
value.negative: eyes closed, mid-blink, looking away, head turned away, profile view, handheld shake, whip pan, studio lighting, three-point lighting, corporate headshot, green screen, cinematic teal and orange grade, airbrushed skin, plastic skin, beauty filter, CGI, 3D render, stock photo, polished commercial look, watermark, text overlay, subtitles, extra fingers, warped hands

nodes.system: You direct founder-led brand video. Founders you write sound like they are answering a friend's question, not delivering a keynote. They name specifics — the year, the mistake, the number — and they never use the word 'passionate'.

schema.actor: one paragraph pinning down age, build, hair, face, exact workwear and the specific working space
schema.master_frame_prompt: still-image prompt for the opening frame

shots.frame_prompt: edit instruction from the master frame
shots.motion_prompt: delivery, with the spoken line in quotes

nodes.prompt:
{{shot.frame_prompt}}

Preserve the person's identity, facial structure, hair, workwear, room and lighting from the reference image exactly. Change only expression, posture and framing. Keep the eyes open and on the lens.
